references.title: en.wiktionary: Ring
references.supports: Noun, a ring; no German split

notes.rationale: Ring, Ring - ... einen Sagenkönig dieses Namens, the name of a legendary king, a character (figure and motif) with a Core gender (Masc); the common noun Ring is one no dictionary splits. No dictionary splits it within German, and a PROPN has no Source (ADR 0050 gives Sources to NOUN, VERB and ADJ only), so it is a bottom word: the Root ring and the zero ending, since PROPN has an ending slot (ADR 0051).
